profile.summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 9+ years of experience building distributed systems across iGaming, healthcare, high-traffic media, and enterprise sports events. I specialize in designing and maintaining microservices using Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, and event-driven patterns. My core stack is PHP (Symfony), and I am comfortable working across other backend languages when the problem requires it. I care about clean architecture, thoughtful decisions, and code the team can still maintain two years from now. Based in Valencia, Spain — open to senior backend roles, remote or hybrid, across Europe and the US.

responsibilities: Leading backend development of a core microservice in a distributed event-support platform used at major international sports events (Paris 2024, Milano Cortina 2026)

Contributing to several microservices across the company, reviewing code and driving consistency in quality and patterns

Collaborating closely with product, QA, and other backend teams in a distributed, remote-first setup
Stack: PHP 8, Symfony, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD
